title: Annotated AAPL extrema
intent: Show Apple closing prices while calling out the exact minimum and maximum observations.

ai.create: Create a UTC time-series line from the AAPL dataset and annotate its minimum and maximum closing prices without preselecting the Plot data.
ai.maintain: Change the selected date window while preserving the original Date and Close fields, unique extrema selection, stable point keys, inferred extents, and labels that stay inside the plot.
